cap: Each embryonic structure has one adult fate, so its origin predicts its disorders. Neural crest cells become the adrenal medulla, ganglia, Schwann cells, melanocytes and enteric ganglia, while the adrenal cortex is mesoderm; failed migration gives Hirschsprung disease. At the umbilicus the allantois closes into the urachus, the vitelline duct disappears, the umbilical vein becomes the ligamentum teres and the arteries become the medial umbilical ligaments.
teach: The adrenal gland is two glands in one: the cortex is mesoderm and the medulla is neural crest, so a question about adrenal origin has two answers depending on the layer. Urine at the umbilicus is a patent urachus, the open channel from the bladder to the umbilicus, whereas stool at the umbilicus is a patent vitelline duct from the ileum.
